hard.how: Follow markets daily with a free news source. Keep a simple log of what moved and why, and a paper portfolio to test your ideas.
hard.proof: A dated log or paper portfolio with your reasoning.

vet.degree_note: Becoming a vet requires an accredited veterinary degree, and admission is highly competitive. Practical work with animals is expected well before you apply.

hard.how: Arrange work at a vet practice, farm, kennel or rescue centre.
Aim for top grades in sciences, and read beyond the syllabus.
Take customer-facing jobs, and practise explaining.
Reflect on difficult experiences and how you coped.

police.degree_note: Entry routes vary by force and nation: some offer degree-level entry, apprenticeships or direct entry. Check each force's current requirements: Police Scotland sets its own.
